scope: Clarify evidence-access terminology; no change to frozen inference or score protocols
opaque_archive_hashing: Source .pt file SHA verification reads complete opaque archive bytes, including bytes belonging to GT storage. This is not a claim of zero GT-containing byte I/O.
export_firewall: The selective metadata/LQ reader opens only LQ tensor storage entries. It neither deserializes GT storage entries into tensors nor interprets GT pixel values. HVI receives canonical RGB LQ only and computes no scores.
fit_diagnostic: The separately frozen source FIT diagnostic intentionally reads GT label tensors from its 102 selected FIT archives for final scoring, with explicit BGR-to-RGB conversion. GT is not an input to prediction; the 17 excluded-scene tensor archives are not opened by this diagnostic.
original_raw_audit: The original-archive audit extracts only 32 selected FIT LQ members and compares their bytes and pixels; no GT archive member is extracted.
interpretation: Fields named gt_storage_entries_read refer to selective tensor-entry deserialization, not opaque whole-file checksum I/O. No source or target label is used to select color order.
